__doc__: Manual data corrections. Key each entry by the local's NUMBER (e.g. "606"); when a number is shared by several rows the export/apply step tells you and you switch that one to its slug (the `id` in the ranked list, e.g. "l26-roanoke-va"). Wage/benefit numbers: your value is kept unless a scrape finds a HIGHER number — add a field name to `force` to always keep yours. Text fields (city, state, lat, lng, wage_sheet_url, source_updated): your value always wins. `note`/`source`/`date` are ignored. See README > Manual corrections. Delete entries once the scrape has caught up.
